# couchbase-capella-aidp_model_activation (Resource)

Manages pause/resume (activation state) for a Capella AI model. Destroying this resource only removes it from Terraform state and does not change the model activation state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "couchbase-capella-aidp_model_activation" "example" {
  organization_id  = var.organization_id
  model_id         = couchbase-capella-aidp_model.example.id
  activation_state = "on"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `activation_state` (String) Desired activation state: "on" (resume) or "off" (pause). Applying the same state the model already has is a no-op (newly deployed models are already "on"/healthy).
- `model_id` (String)
- `organization_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) Current model status after applying the activation change.
